description.default: The Teams channel ID of the default channel where flow failure alert messages will be posted. This is the internal channel identifier starting with "19:" — visible in the channel URL after /channel/ in the Teams web or desktop client (URL-decode %3A to : and %40 to @). Used as the fallback destination when no Alert Route matches an incoming error. Add Alert Route records to route specific solutions to different channels.
